sources.snippet: Image-Text Retrieval Relevant source files Purpose and Scope This document explains how to fine-tune the ALBEF model for image-text retrieval tasks on MSCOCO and Flickr30k datasets. It covers the necessary steps for dataset preparation, configuration, and training, as well as using pre-trained checkpoints for inference.
